Project Engineering Manager - Core Spreads Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Location: Pratau, Germany

On-site

About the position

As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice (by travelling) factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.

You will:

  • Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.
  • Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.
  • Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.
  • Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.
  • Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.
  • Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.
  • Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.
  • Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.
  • Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.
  • Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.
  • Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.
  • Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.
  • Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.
  • Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.
  • Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.
  • Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

So what does it take to be successful in this role?  

You have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience in project engineering, process engineering, maintenance engineering, or capital project delivery within the food industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment. You bring solid knowledge of food processing, packaging technologies, hygienic design principles, operational excellence, and change management practices. You have a strong understanding of engineering project delivery processes, industrial equipment, utilities, process systems, packaging lines, commissioning, and operational handover. You have demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, suppliers, contractors, risks, and cross-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing environment, and are able to balance strategic project objectives with practical factory execution, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term site and category manufacturing strategies. You are fluent in both English and German, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, open to traveling for project execution, supplier visits, factory acceptance tests (FATs), and on-site activities. Additionally, you are proficient in MS Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.

jobs.title: Partnership Account Director
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!


YOUR MISSION

Please note - this is a field-based role.
We have an exciting opportunity to join Carwow in the role of Partnership Account
Director. In this role, you will lead SLT / Executive level working relationships with
the highest contact levels of our Enterprise / Franchise Dealer groups, embedding
Carwow as their most efficient, effective & valued stock sourcing partner across
various Sell My Car products.
You will work autonomously, ensuring revenue growth in line with company
growth targets in a high-performance culture. Our Partnership Account Directors
influence how Enterprise / Franchise Dealer groups communicate and work with
Carwow across their Dealerships to deliver results and efficiency.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Opening up and developing new partner relationships with target
    organisations using internal and external networking levers

  • Understanding the Carwow stock buying solution and where it stands in the
    market and be able to deliver highly polished and engaging sales
    presentations

  • Embed Carwow into the heart of all Dealer Partners as one of their most
    valued stock-sourcing solutions

  • Deliver long-term sustained revenue growth by increasing the number of
    the buyers on the platform and the volume of stock buying across your
    retailer network

  • Provide an outstanding level of account management to our partners and
    help them achieve their commercial objectives by thoroughly
    understanding the fundamentals of their businesses

  • Work closely with the Account Managers to help them deliver on joint
    business plans, identify areas of challenge and work these through at
    senior levels of the organisation

  • Develop strong, trusted relationships with the largest group contacts

  • Effectively manage CRM through Salesforce to maintain accurately & up to
    date data for you and your team.

  • Generate and collate contributions to product innovation and marketing
    initiatives.

  • Develop & maintain an in-depth understanding of how the automotive
    industry works

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • Experienced influencer and negotiator, with strong account management
    experience

  • Ability to analyse and manipulate data to identify and communicate
    opportunities and risks and deploy growth strategies.

  • Flexible communication skills

  • Proven ability to prioritise effectively to deliver on goals and objectives set

  • A high level of business acumen, analytical skills and a problem solver

  • Flexible and adaptable leadership style to positively lead teams through
    change

  • Energetic & enthusiastic, able to help other navigate change

  • Highly driven, motivated to win

  • Adept communication at SLT - Exec level

  • Commercially focused and highly numerate

  • An active listener with a high level of integrity

  • Strong influencer

  • Emotionally intelligent

  • Focused on the success of others

  • Solution-oriented – a problem solver

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Step one (Suitability & Experience): Interview with the Hiring Manager and
    Partnership Account Director (PAD) lead to deep-dive into your strategic
    experience, regional knowledge, and overall suitability for the role

  • Step two (Competency & Task-Based): A task-based interview focusing on
    commercial competency, strategic thinking, and ability to deliver in the role
    (e.g., a case study presentation).

  • Step three (Final & Leadership): A face-to-face interview with the Hiring
    Manager and key Senior Executive contacts in the business to assess your
    leadership style and commercial influence.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Competitive comp package

  • 28 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 35 with length of service, plus extras for house moves, weddings and more!

  • Employee-friendly share options

  • Pension scheme via Royal London - up to 5% company contribution

  • Vitality private healthcare insurance

  • Life Assurance - 4x annual salary

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave including up to 20 weeks' full pay maternity and shared parental leave, and 8 weeks' full partner pay, as well as fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • 'Work from abroad for a month' annual scheme

  • Generous learning and development budget

  • £500 home office budget

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers.

Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars.

We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses.

That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years.

  • Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger.

  • Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience.

  • Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it.

  • Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers.

  • Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems.

  • Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better.

  • Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself.

  • You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple.

  • You’ll have experience designing for a marketplace, platform or similarly complex product with very different types of users. You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both.

  • You’ll also need to be a great partner to Product and Engineering — able to challenge, listen, bring people together and make the product better.

  • Automotive experience isn’t important. We’d much rather find someone who brings a fresh perspective and has helped build products people genuinely love using.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • A year from now, we should be able to see and feel the difference.

  • We should have a clear, shared vision for the Carwow experience across customers and dealers, with meaningful progress towards making it real.

  • Our customer and dealer experiences should feel more connected, and we should be able to point to measurable improvements in the experiences and outcomes that matter most.

  • The quality and consistency of our design should be noticeably higher, with a stronger design team doing some of the best work of their careers.

  • Most importantly, we should be closer to building a Carwow that customers want to come back to whenever they change their car, and that dealers wouldn’t want to run their business without.

WHY CARWOW?

  • Genuine scale and impact: your work is used by millions of car buyers and sellers

  • An AI-forward culture where new tools and workflows are embraced, not resisted — with access to the best tooling available

  • A senior, supportive design team that takes craft seriously

  • Hybrid working, competitive salary and equity, private healthcare, enhanced parental leave, and a car-buying perk you'd expect from us

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

jobs.description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

  • You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Your potential growth path:

  • Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

  • Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

  • 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

Your performance objectives

📣 Generate pipeline

  • Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

  • Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

  • Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

💪 Close opportunities

  • Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

  • Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

  • Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.

💡 Build expertise

  • Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.

  • Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.

📈 Lead by example

  • Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.

  • Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.

  • Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

🇪🇺 Your territory

You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

 

📍 Work location

Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement

  • Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap

💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles—see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.

jobs.title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

As Technical Lead, Laser Amplification, you will own the end-to-end technical delivery of the laser amplification subsystem. The amplification chain is the primary energy-scaling element of the laser system, so this role is central to translating ICF system requirements into an integrated, high-performing function.

You will define the subsystem architecture, establish the technical roadmap, lead design and test activities, manage interfaces and risks, and develop the team and capabilities needed to take the amplification chain from concept through hardware delivery and integration.


What you’ll do

  • Define and own the technical architecture for Main Amplifier systems from concept through design freeze, including topology, gain media, pump geometry, thermal management, ASE control, and interface specifications.

  • Ensure that the amplification architecture and development activities remain traceable to ICF system-level laser requirements.

  • Build and maintain the technical roadmap for Light Amplification, aligning development sequence, capability gaps, technology maturity, and program milestones.

  • Lead the design, build, characterization, and integration of the amplification chain.

  • Deliver subsystem performance to agreed specifications for energy, gain, beam quality, pulse contrast, and reliability.

  • Own the technical risk register, define mitigations and owners, and escalate risks early—before they become schedule or performance issues.

  • Define maturity gates for key amplification subsystems and technologies, and drive focused development activities to close demonstration gaps.

  • Own technical interfaces with adjacent functions, including Light Generation, Light Conditioning, Beam Transport, and Focusing.

  • Represent Light Amplification in system-level design reviews and communicate decisions, progress, dependencies, and risks clearly to technical and leadership audiences.

  • Build and develop the Amplification team by hiring engineers and scientists, setting clear expectations, providing feedback, and growing technical and leadership capability.

Who You Are

  • A PhD or equivalent experience in laser physics, photonics, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience leading a technical team by setting direction, developing people, and maintaining effective communication across organizational boundaries.

  • Hands-on experience with high-energy or high-power laser amplification systems, including solid-state, fiber, or diode-pumped architectures.

  • Strong understanding of gain media physics, thermal effects, wavefront distortion, ASE, pulse contrast, and beam quality in amplifier chains.

  • Experience taking a laser subsystem from concept through hardware delivery, characterization, and integration.

  • The ability to own a technical scope, make decisions under uncertainty, and communicate clearly with both technical and leadership audiences.

  • Experience working in a matrix organization with shared resources and cross-functional dependencies.

  • A structured approach to requirements definition, traceability, risk management, root-cause analysis, and technical decision-making.

Nice to have

  • Experience in an ICF, high-power laser facility, or defense laser program.

  • Familiarity with amplification architectures.

  • Experience with diode-pumped solid-state amplifiers at the joule scale or more.

  • Experience with coaching, mentoring, performance management, hiring, onboarding, and team building.

  • Experience applying systems engineering and design-for-cost or design-for-manufacturing methods in a complex hardware program.


Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

This is our first dedicated people hire, and it sits at director level for a reason. You will not be inheriting a function, you will be building and then leading one.   • Set and own the people strategy, aligned with our growth plans and company values, and act as a trusted advisor to the founders and leadership team

Why Join

You would be the first person in this role and the person who defines how our people function takes shape, with real ownership and a direct line to leadership. We are a deep-tech company solving genuinely hard problems, and the team around you reflects that. The environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer relocation support for the right person, with the choice of being based in Berlin or Dresden. If you want to build and lead something meaningful rather than maintain something that already exists, this is that kind of role.

jobs.description:
Jeg er en kjekk ung kvinne på 31 år som trenger bistand i alle hverdagslige gjøremål Vi søker nå etter deg som er engasjert og dyktig i din sykepleierrolle til vårt team i Kristiansund. Hos oss vil du få muligheten til å arbeide i et inkluderende og faglig sterkt miljø, hvor vedtakseiers helse og trivsel alltid står i fokus. Ordningen har 2-1 bemanning på dag og kveld, hvor man er en høyskoleutdannet med legemiddelkompetanse, og en faglært/ufaglært assistent på jobb. Arbeidstid består av langvakter/døgnvakter, med lengre friperioder. 

Hos oss vil du arbeide tverrfaglig med andre instanser opp mot vedtakseier og arbeidsleder. Sykepleierne/vernepleierne i ordningen har det overordnede ansvaret når det kommer til det medisinske og det å ha et helhetlig helseperspektiv i arbeidshverdagen.

Stilling:

Vi søker en sykepleier som tilkallingsvikar, og siden ordningen er stor, vil der være mulighet for en god del jobbing. Assistansen er døgnkontinuerlig med et fast team av assistenter som jobber i 2-1 assistanse. Vi tilstreber å gjøre turnusen så attraktiv som mulig, og det reflekteres i gode tilbakemeldinger fra våre ansatte. Som tilkalling vil du både kunne få tilbud om enkeltvakter eller etterfølgende døgnvakter med passiv natt og gode hvileordninger.


Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Utdannet sykepleier
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å jobbe selvstendig
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • God orden og tilretteleggingsevne
  • Over 23 år grunnet forsikring på bil
  • Førerkort på automat 

 

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Du er ansvarsbevisst og punktlig
  • Du har evne til å takle utfordrende situasjoner 
  • Du trives med å jobbe i et hektisk arbeidsmiljø og tar initiativ der det trengs
  • Du er fleksibel og serviceinnstilt

  • Det er viktig at du blir godt kjent med meg og kan skape forutsigbarhet og trygghet i hverdagen

jobs.title: Ekonomichef
jobs.description:
Välkommen till den lilla och styrkebaserade kommunen med stora möjligheter!

Här har du chansen att bidra med samhällsviktiga tjänster, till de vi är till för, tillsammans med dina kollegor. Vi utgår ifrån friskfaktorer och har ett styrkebaserat förhållningssätt som fokuserar på människors samt organisationens styrkor. Det är också det vi kommunicerar och ger återkoppling på. Du ges hållbara arbetsvillkor, förutsättningar att växa och bidra till det kollegiala lärandet. Vi vägleds av utvecklingskraft, stolthet och medmänsklighet och det förväntar vi oss att du också gör.

Om verksamheten

Kommunledningsförvaltningen är kommunstyrelsens stöd- och stabsförvaltning. Förvaltningen samlar flera kommunövergripande funktioner och har en viktig roll i att skapa riktning, samordning och genomförandekraft i hela organisationen.

Ekonomiavdelningen ansvarar bland annat för kommunens ekonomiska planering, budget, uppföljning, analys, redovisning och bokslut. Avdelningen ger kvalificerat stöd till kommunens verksamheter, chefer, kommunledning och förtroendevalda.

Vi befinner oss i ett spännande utvecklingsskede där vi stärker vår ledning och styrning, utvecklar våra arbetssätt och skapar bättre förutsättningar att omsätta politiska mål i handling. Som ekonomichef får du en central roll i den fortsatta utvecklingen.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som ekonomichef leder du ekonomiavdelningen och ansvarar för verksamhet, ekonomi, personal, arbetsmiljö och utveckling. Du skapar riktning, struktur och goda förutsättningar för medarbetarna och utvecklar tillsammans med dem kommunens ekonomistyrning och ekonomiska processer.

Vi söker en chef som är närvarande i vardagen, kommunicerar tydligt och skapar delaktighet. Du leder med tillit och tydliga förväntningar, ger återkoppling och tar vara på medarbetarnas kompetens och drivkraft.

Uppdraget omfattar tre perspektiv: att leda och utveckla ekonomiavdelningen, bidra till kommunledningsförvaltningens samlade uppdrag och ta ansvar för kommunövergripande frågor. Du ingår i kommunledningsförvaltningens ledningsgrupp och bidrar till gemensam ledning, prioritering och utveckling.

På kommunövergripande nivå leder, samordnar och utvecklar du arbetet med ekonomisk planering, budget, uppföljning, analys, redovisning och bokslut. Du bidrar med ett långsiktigt ekonomiskt perspektiv och tydliggör sambandet mellan ekonomi, verksamhet och politiska mål.

Du gör komplexa ekonomiska frågor begripliga och är ett kvalificerat bollplank till chefer, kommunledning och förtroendevalda inför beslut och prioriteringar. Du utvecklar även arbetssätt, processer och beslutsunderlag som stärker kommunens långsiktiga ekonomiska hållbarhet.

Din närmaste chef är biträdande kommunchef, tillika förvaltningschef för kommunledningsförvaltningen. Du rapporterar och föredrar ekonomiska frågor för kommunchefen, kommunstyrelsen och andra politiska forum.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:

    relevant akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig goda kunskaper om kommunal ekonomi och ekonomistyrning
    erfarenhet av kvalificerat ekonomiarbete på strategisk och operativ nivå chefserfarenhet med ansvar för verksamhet, ekonomi, personal och arbetsmiljö
    erfarenhet från en kommunal eller annan politiskt styrd organisation förmåga att kommunicera ekonomiska frågor tydligt till olika målgrupper
    dokumenterat god erfarenhet av att leda utvecklings- och förändringsarbete.

Du rör dig tryggt mellan strategisk utveckling och verksamhetens vardag. Som ledare är du närvarande, lyhörd och tydlig. Du skapar förtroende och delaktighet och har integritet och mod att ge välgrundade råd även i komplexa frågor. Du är prestigelös, tar vara på andras perspektiv och bidrar till ett öppet och lärande klimat.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Övrig information

Vi tillämpar kompetensbaserad rekrytering. Du besvarar därför urvalsfrågor som ersätter CV och personligt brev. Dina svar blir underlag för vår bedömning av din ansökan.

Urval och intervjuer kan ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

Tjänsten kan komma att placeras i säkerhetsklass. För slutkandidaten kan därför säkerhetsprövning genomföras, innefattande registerkontroll, säkerhetsprövningssamtal och särskild personutredning. För vissa tjänster krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

Tester och arbetsprov ingår i rekryteringsprocessen. Vi genomför även bakgrundskontroll av slutkandidaten, bland annat genom kontroll av examensbevis eller annat dokument som styrker utbildningen.

Ansökan

Logga in/skapa en användare först innan du fyller i din ansökan.

Kontakter fritext

Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden. I denna rekryteringsprocess ansöker du enbart med CV. Vi tillämpar kompetensbaserad rekrytering med stöd i arbetsprover som urvalsmetod för att säkerställa en rättvis och träffsäker rekryteringsprocess.

Varför jobba hos oss? Du får:

    Påverkan och närhet - Hos oss är vägen från idé till beslut kort. Vi arbetar nära varandra, oavsett roll eller funktion. Här får du chansen att göra skillnad!
    Livskvalitet och friskfaktorer - I vår kommun arbetar vi aktivt med friskfaktorer, vilket gör oss unika. Vårt fokus ligger på det sunda, det friska och salutogena hos människor. Du som medarbetare är värdefull för oss!
    Prestigelöshet och enkelhet - Här är det enkelt att jobba, leva och vara. Genom att prioritera samarbeten och skapa attraktiva livsmiljöer gör vi det enkelt och attraktivt att vara verksam här.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

Using your security engineering skills, you will, for example, develop tooling for AI-assisted penetration testing within our team and translate it into practical, scalable processes.

Your skillset

jobs.title: Nattpersonal Ainagården
jobs.description:
Vill du ha ett roligt och värdefullt jobb? Ett jobb där du arbetar med människor som kanske inte alltid tänker som alla andra men som kan berika din dag och där du får en chans att göra skillnad i någons vardag.

Vårt arbete styrs av våra värderingar som är respekt, engagemang, ansvar samt boendefokus. Vår vision är att vi ska skapa livskvalité utifrån varje individs behov.



Vår verksamhet ligger i natursköna Dänningelanda ca 1 mil söder om Växjö. I Dänningelanda har vi flera verksamheter men nu söker vi dig som vill arbeta på Ainagården som är ett gruppboende med 6 platser.

Du bör ha intresse av att ge vård och omsorg till de boende som har olika funktionsvariationer. I verksamheten finns personer med varierande behov inom psykiatri/autismspektrum/intellektuell funktionsnedsättning men även personer som har ett stort omvårdnadsbehov/rullstol och som behöver stöd i alla vardagliga aktiviteter.

Vi söker en engagerade boendestödjare som gör allt för att de boende på Ainagården ska trivas och känna trygghet. Vi vill att du ska arbeta utifrån ett lågaffektivt arbetssätt, vara öppen för förändringar som sker i verksamheten samt kunna arbeta tillsammans med dina kollegor utifrån de rutiner och strukturer som råder på arbetsplatsen.



Anställning: Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag med 2500 kr/år Tillträde november 2026 eller efter överenskommelse. Tjänstgöringsgrad ca 70 procent. Vi tillämpar provanställning med 6 månader samt individuell lönesättning. Vi har kollektivavtal med Kommunal.



Ditt uppdrag: Du ansvarar för att skapa trygghet och struktur för de boende utifrån deras behov nattetid. Du ska bistå i enklar sysslor, så som en del städ och beställningar. Du samarbetar med nattpersonal på andra verksamheter för att skapa trygghet och stabilitet.

Du utgår alltid från varje boendes individuella behov och rätten till självbestämmande. En stor del av arbetet består i att utifrån varje boendes förutsättningar bidra till den boendes självständighet och välmående, samt anpassa din kommunikation så att de boende på Ainagården känner att du förstår samt respekterar dem.

Arbetet innebär administrativa arbetsuppgifter såsom social dokumentation, vilket förutsätter god datavana.

Du ska ha ett professionellt men ändå nära, motiverande och trygghetsskapande arbetssätt gentemot de boende du ansvarar för. Du kommer att arbeta vaken natt på rullande schema.



Kvalifikationer :Att du är utbildad undersköterska eller har en annan likvärdig utbildning med pedagogisk inriktning. Du bör har god datorvana samt erfarenhet av dokumentation. Som person är du ansvarstagande, trygg, engagerad och har en positiv inställning. Du ska ha B-körkort. Du ska behärska svenska i tal o skrift.

Meriterande: Utbildning eller arbetslivserfarenhet inom Lågaffektivt bemötande - studio 3 Erfarenhet av arbete inom LSS. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med tydliggörande pedagogik. Att du har kunskap i dokumentation enligt IBIC. Erfarenhet inom omvårdnad.

Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Chef de Projet Senior Photovoltaïque & stockage (BESS) (H/F) et contribuez à la transition vers un avenir énergétique durable et décarboné !

Principales responsabilités

  • Assurer la gestion de projets stratégiques internationaux dans les domaines du photovoltaïque et des systèmes de stockage d'énergie par batteries (BESS). Les clients comprennent notamment des institutions financières internationales (AFD, KfW, Banque mondiale, BERD, BEI, etc.), des compagnies nationales d'électricité ainsi que d'importants clients privés (industriels, développeurs de projets, etc.).

  • Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

jobs.title: Post-doctorat en interprétabilité mécaniste et diversité des représentations
jobs.description:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité.

Le projet explore cette question sur deux plans complémentaires : la diversité des données, soit le choix des exemples que l'on annote, conserve ou présente au modèle ; et la diversité des représentations, soit le choix des descripteurs, des contextes et des modèles que l'on exploite ou

combine. Les premiers résultats portent sur le décodage diversifié des modèles de langue à diffusion discrète et sur la localisation de l'information dans les représentations des transformers.

Le poste proposé porte sur le second plan, abordé par les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Page du

projet : https://bastienpasdeloup.github.io/endive/

MISSIONS

Les missions principales du poste sont les suivantes :

  1. Définir et évaluer des critères de diversité dans l'espace des représentations des modèles de

fondation, en s'appuyant sur les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

2. Étudier le lien entre la diversité des données d'entraînement et la diversité des mécanismes internes

que les modèles acquièrent.

3. Contribuer à la production et à la diffusion scientifiques du projet.

ACTIVITÉS :

  1. Critères de diversité dans les représentations :

• Entraîner et analyser des autoencodeurs parcimonieux sur les activations de modèles de

fondation, afin d'en extraire des descripteurs interprétables.

• Construire des noyaux de similarité entre ces descripteurs et évaluer, au moyen de processus

ponctuels déterminantaux, si un sous-ensemble divers en fournit une couverture plus

compacte que la seule importance individuelle.

• Mesurer l'effet de ces critères sur des tâches aval en régime peu annoté, et comparer les

profondeurs du réseau auxquelles les représentations sont lues.

2. Diversité des données et diversité des mécanismes :

• Comparer les descripteurs retrouvés par des autoencodeurs parcimonieux entraînés sur des

modèles nourris de régimes de données différents, et quantifier leur recouvrement.

• Évaluer la stabilité de ces descripteurs d'un entraînement à l'autre, afin de distinguer les

mécanismes reproductibles des artefacts d'optimisation.

• Mettre ces mesures en relation avec les procédures de curation étudiées dans le projet, en

particulier pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète.

3. Production scientifique et vie du projet :

• Rédiger et soumettre les résultats obtenus dans des conférences et revues internationales.

• Publie le code et les protocoles expérimentaux nécessaires à la reproductibilité des résultats.

  • Découvrir toutes les étapes de conception d'un produit digital, de l'idée jusqu'à sa mise entre les mains de plusieurs centaines de milliers de joueurs.
 

Ce que tu vas accomplir :

Au fil du stage, tu seras donc progressivement intégré au processus de définition et de pilotage de nos projets produits. Cette montée en compétence te conduira à ton projet de fin de stage : repenser et optimiser l'expérience d'accueil et d'intégration du nouveau joueur.

Ton objectif : t'appuyer sur l'identification des barrières à l'entrée et l'analyse des faiblesses de notre application pour concevoir, en collaboration avec un UI/UX Designer, une solution capable d'augmenter durablement la rétention des nouveaux joueurs sur notre application.

jobs.title: Integrationsarkitekt inom BizTalk och Azure
jobs.description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i en central arkitektroll i en komplex och samhällsviktig verksamhet där integrationer är avgörande för stabila processer och informationsflöden. Fokus ligger på att vidareutveckla integrationsplattformen och driva en stegvis modernisering från BizTalk Server till Azure Integration Services.

Rollen kombinerar strategiskt arkitekturarbete med operativt tekniskt stöd. Du arbetar nära utvecklingsteam, förvaltning och verksamhet för att omsätta behov till robusta, säkra och skalbara integrationslösningar. Det här är en intressant möjlighet för dig som vill påverka både målbild, tekniska vägval och framtidens integrationsarkitektur.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Du ansvarar för målbild, arkitektur och vidareutveckling av integrationsplattformen.
    Du planerar, driver och vägleder modernisering och migrering från BizTalk Server till Azure Integration Services.
    Du utformar och kvalitetssäkrar integrationslösningar med exempelvis Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus och Event Grid.
    Du arbetar med befintliga integrationsflöden i BizTalk och säkerställer kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktig förvaltningsbarhet.
    Du tar fram och vidareutvecklar integrationsprinciper, arkitekturella riktlinjer, ramverk och best practices.
    Du ansvarar för arkitekturella vägval och säkerställer att lösningar följer beslutade principer och målarkitektur.
    Du deltar i kravanalys och omsätter verksamhetsbehov till tekniska specifikationer och integrationslösningar.
    Du stöttar utvecklingsteam och förvaltning med teknisk vägledning, designstöd och beslut kring integrationsmönster och tekniska komponenter.
    Du designar lösningar med fokus på prestanda, säkerhet, skalbarhet, robusthet och hög tillgänglighet.
    Du driver kontinuerliga förbättringar och bidrar som teknisk expert i projekt, utvecklingsinitiativ och större förändringsprogram.

Krav

    Minst 5 års erfarenhet av arbete som integrationsarkitekt.
    Minst 3 års erfarenhet av BizTalk Server, inklusive design, utveckling och förvaltning av integrationslösningar.
    Minst 3 års erfarenhet av Azure Integration Services, exempelvis Logic Apps, API Management och Service Bus.
    Minst 3 års praktisk erfarenhet av att designa integrationslösningar baserade på integrationsmönster såsom API, pub/sub, eventdriven integration och batch.
    Minst 3 års erfarenhet av API-design och API-standarder, inklusive REST och OpenAPI.
    Minst 3 års erfarenhet av säkerhet och autentisering i integrationslösningar, exempelvis OAuth 2.0, Managed Identities och liknande mekanismer.
    Erfarenhet av att ta fram integrationsarkitektur, målarkitektur och tekniska vägval samt omsätta dessa i konkreta lösningar.
    Erfarenhet av modernisering eller migrering av integrationslösningar från BizTalk Server till Azure Integration Services.
    Drogtest krävs.

Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll samt tecknande av säkerhetsskyddsavtal enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan komma att genomföras av konsult respektive konsults arbetsgivare innan Uppdragsavtalet kan göras gällande.

Meriterande

    Erfarenhet av att ha drivit eller lett en större migrering från BizTalk Server till Azure Integration Services.
    Erfarenhet av hybrid integration mellan on-premises och molnbaserade miljöer.
    Erfarenhet av CI/CD, DevOps och automatisering i Azure.
    Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Bicep eller Terraform.
    Erfarenhet av övervakning, loggning, observability och felsökning av integrationsplattformar i Azure.
    Erfarenhet av att ta fram integrations principer, riktlinjer, ramverk och best practices.

Vi erbjuder

    Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
    Tjänstepension
    Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år

Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

jobs.title: Solutions and Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About The Role

We're looking for a Solutions and Implementation Manager to join our Customer Experience team, managing the delivery and implementation of Micad FM, our estates management platform, for our UK customer base. We're bolstering the team ahead of a high volume of upcoming implementations.

In this role, you'll be the technical expert who bridges the gap between sales and Customer Success – owning the customer journey from pre-sales through to complete implementation. If you're excited about managing complex technical projects, solving implementation challenges, and being the linchpin between our commercial and delivery teams, this is the opportunity for you!

Where will you be based? This role is remote within the UK, and the Cardiff area is our preference. If you're near Cardiff, we'd ask you to co-locate with the team around once a week; if you're based elsewhere in the UK, we bring the team together in person roughly once a quarter.

Our projects can be delivered remotely, but we travel to client sites where it's beneficial for the customer — expect an average of about one trip a month, so you'll need to be open to travel.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead customer onboarding and implementation – own the technical deployment of Micad FM for UK customers, configuring solutions to meet their specific requirements, delivering training, and ensuring successful go-live.

  • Act as a technical advisor and product expert – develop deep knowledge of Micad FM to guide customers through complex configurations, troubleshoot technical issues, demonstrate ROI, and identify opportunities to expand usage across their organisation.

  • Drive revenue growth and expansion – lead technical product discovery and demonstrations with Sales to scope additional modules, integrations, and services that deliver value.

  • Conduct strategic Success Planning – lead Success planning sessions with key accounts, demonstrating measurable outcomes and ensuring alignment between customer objectives and our solutions.

  • Work cross-functionally – partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product and Engineering to deliver a joined-up customer experience, provide product feedback, and advocate for customer needs internally.

  • Build the team and the playbook – work with our implementation lead to develop repeatable delivery processes, mentor colleagues, and help shape a high-performing implementation function as we scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Technical implementation experience – you have a proven track record in implementation, technical account management, or solutions consulting roles (ideally in SaaS, PropTech, CAFM, or B2B software), with the ability to configure and deploy software solutions.

  • Sales acumen and commercial awareness – you understand the customer lifecycle, can articulate ROI, and work collaboratively with sales teams to drive revenue growth.

  • Strong technical aptitude – you're comfortable learning complex software platforms, troubleshooting issues, and training end-users on best practices.

  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder – you can translate technical concepts into business value, build trust with stakeholders at all levels, and navigate complex organisational dynamics.

  • Data-driven and technically proficient – you're comfortable with CRM software (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), project management tools (e.g., Jira), and analysing customer data to drive decisions and demonstrate value.

What Success looks like in this role

You'll be measured on implementation completion rates, time to value, and the quality of technical engagement that moves deals to closed won.

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Solutions and Implementation Team Lead and work closely with our Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams across SINGU. Our teams are highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences and growth.

 

Why join SINGU?

  • Permanent contract with a competitive yearly salary, based on your experience.

  • A collaborative, no-micromanagement culture — we trust you to deliver.

  • Part of a fast-scaling, international group redefining how real estate is managed.

  • Private equity-backed and a year into a three-to-five-year investment horizon — fast-paced, target-driven, with the budget and autonomy already in place to deliver.

  • Genuine scope to put your mark here — as the team scales, you'll help shape how we deliver and progress quickly with it.

  • Real ownership from day one — you'll lead technical implementations end to end, from sale through to successful go-live.

  • A pivotal moment to join — we're taking service delivery to the next level and looking for people ready to get stuck in and make a real impact.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer | Intch
jobs.description:
About Intch

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months.

The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch.

Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online. Changes that made the interface feel more like a real conversation have already improved key metrics by up to three times.

About the role

Today one part time designer supports all Intch products. Since the company moved to a product based structure, that is no longer enough. Intch is now looking for its first full time designer.

Product managers build and test early prototypes themselves. Around one in ten experiments moves forward. Your role is to join the thinking early, work through the problem with the product team and turn validated ideas into clear, production ready experiences.

This is a hands on role with broad ownership. You will work across all Intch products and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers and the current designer.

What you will work on

  • Join product discussions early and help shape the problem before screens are made.

  • Take a task from an open question to a production ready design.

  • Design flows where the interface supports communication between people and businesses.

  • Work on onboarding, profiles, discovery, paywalls and other core product areas.

  • Cover key states, edge cases and handoff details, then stay involved during implementation.

  • Extend the existing UI kit and keep patterns consistent across products.

  • Increase the share of design work that can move into production without another rework round.

What matters for this role

  • Strong UI craft and a portfolio of clear, thoughtful interfaces.

  • Solid web product experience. Web is the primary platform at Intch.

  • The ability to explain your decisions through user context, not personal taste.

  • Openness to evidence and the confidence to change your mind when a better argument appears.

  • Experience owning design from an unclear problem through to launch.

  • Comfort working with autonomy in a small product company.

  • Experience in a startup, as a founding designer or in an in-house product role, would be useful.

  • A practical approach to AI tools. The current workflow includes Figma handoff and clickable prototypes in Claude. Production code is not expected.

  • English at B1, fluent Russian.

What you get

  • Remote, open geography. Time zone overlap with ~CET is what matters.

  • Flexible schedule. Paid vacation, sick leave, and days off.

  • A flat team under 40 where you can bring a worked-out idea into any product — and get paid for it if it performs.

  • A design problem the market hasn't solved yet, in a product used across 140 countries.

  • Real autonomy from day one. You'll sit in product discussions, not receive tickets.

jobs.title: Flera Mättekniker sökes – Stockholm

Om jobbet

Rixma AB söker nu flera drivna och självgående mättekniker för uppdrag i Stockholm.

jobs.title: Trygg och lyhörd personlig assistent till mig i Älvsjö
jobs.employer: Assistans i balans i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Om mig

Jag är en 12-årig tjej som bor i Älvsjö tillsammans med min familj. Nu söker jag dig som vill vara en viktig del av min vardag och som kan ge mig stöd på ett tryggt, lyhört och närvarande sätt.

Hos mig får du ett arbete där du gör skillnad på riktigt. Du finns vid min sida i både skolan, hemma och på olika aktiviteter. Jag behöver dig som kan hjälpa mig att vara delaktig, förstå mina signaler och bidra till att min dag blir så trygg, fungerande och innehållsrik som möjligt.

Jag tycker om när det händer saker omkring mig. På vardagarna går jag i skolan och då följer min assistent med mig dit. Efter skolan och på fritiden tycker jag om att komma iväg på aktiviteter. Jag badar gärna, deltar i olika aktiviteter inom Parasport och följer med min familj på utflykter.

Som min assistent är du med mig i olika miljöer och situationer. Ibland behöver jag stöd i det praktiska, ibland behöver jag hjälp att förstå och vara delaktig i det som händer runt omkring mig. För mig är det viktigt att du är uppmärksam, lugn och trygg, så att du kan ge mig rätt stöd i rätt stund.

Om dig:

Jag söker dig som är varm, tålmodig och stabil. Du behöver vara lyhörd och kunna läsa av mig även när jag inte kommunicerar med ord. Det är viktigt att du är närvarande, nyfiken på att lära känna mig och har respekt för mitt sätt att vara.

Jag tror att du är en person som skapar lugn omkring dig. Du behöver kunna ta egna initiativ när det behövs, men också förstå vikten av att lyssna in mig, min familj och mina rutiner. Jag uppskattar om du är kreativ, flexibel och kan hitta lösningar i vardagen på ett tryggt och naturligt sätt.

Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med barn med funktionsnedsättning tidigare. Det är också en fördel om du har erfarenhet av sondmatning, knapp på magen eller matpump. Det viktigaste är att du är ansvarstagande, vill lära dig och ser arbetet hos mig som något långsiktigt.

Bemanning:

Det ingår ett utökat (och arvoderat) bemanningsuppdrag i den här tjänsten som innebär att man vissa veckor måste vara anträffbar på annan tid än arbetstid, för att i situationer då ingripande krävs ringa in en vikarie eller själv hoppa in och assistera. Detta är Assistans i Balans sätt att säkerställa att våra uppdragsgivare alltid har en välbekant assistent vid sin sida. Uppdraget delas av alla assistenter som arbetar efter ett regelbundet schema.

Tjänsten:

Är på xx% varierad arbetstid, dagar, kvällar och helger på rullande schema. För att anställas måste du uppvisa giltig ID-handling utdrag ur polisregistret och eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige.  

Om Assistans i Balans:

Assistans i Balans anordnar - med lång och egen erfarenhet - högkvalitativ personlig assistans till personer med omfattande funktionsnedsättning i enlighet med LSS och Independent Living-rörelsen. Vi vill bidra till en jämlikare värld där alla oavsett funktionsnedsättning ges en möjlighet att leva ett självständigt liv med självbestämmande och självrespekt i fokus. Vår service är nära, personlig och kontinuerlig och vår ambitionsnivå är hög. Alla medarbetare får grundlig introduktion, fortlöpande utbildning, ta del av vårt värderingsarbete, friskvårdsbidrag och trygghet genom kollektivavtal (Fremia - Kommunal).

Läs mer på www.assistansibalans.se
