jobs.title: Dynamics 365 F&O Developer
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Build the financial engine behind global sustainable impact

 

Do you want to build and evolve the financial technology platform that enables investments — from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to play a pivotal technical role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A central role in evolving our Dynamics 365 F&O platform

  • Collaboration with skilled colleagues, data engineers, and business stakeholders in a friendly, inclusive culture

  • Access to the full Microsoft enterprise stack in a modern, tech-driven environment

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

Please note:

  • This position operates out of our main office in Copenhagen, and regular presence at the office is required. 

  • While we welcome applications and are open to candidates from outside of Denmark, please note that Impact Fund Denmark will not provide relocation assistance.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. We challenge each other, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that make a real difference across the organisation. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our D365 F&O platform

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 F&O Developer to take a key role in developing, customising, and maintaining the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations platform that underpins our financial operations and reporting globally. You will work closely with our Solution Architect, Business Application Manager, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust, scalable, and well-governed solutions.

 

You will, for example:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy customisations and extensions in Dynamics 365 F&O

  • Integrate D365 F&O with other systems in our stack, including Dynamics 365 CE, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, and third-party SaaS applications

  • Configure and optimise financial modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, and Budgeting

  • Collaborate with the Solution Architect to align development work with our enterprise architecture principles and integration patterns

  • Participate in and contribute to requirements workshops, translating business needs into technical designs and functional specifications

  • Support and maintain existing D365 F&O configurations, data entities, and custom solutions — and troubleshoot issues as they arise

  • Contribute to DevOpsSec practices, including ALM, source control, release management, and deployment pipelines

  • Produce clear technical documentation and support knowledge transfer within the team

 

You bring deep F&O expertise and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Dynamics 365 F&O development and configuration, you understand how to turn complex financial requirements into well-engineered solutions that stand the test of time.

 

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Have solid hands-on experience developing in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

  • Are comfortable configuring core financial modules and translating business processes into D365 workflows

  • Have experience with integration patterns and tools, such as Data Entities, OData, Logic Apps, or Azure Integration Services

  • Understand the Power Platform ecosystem (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) and how it connects to F&O

  • Are familiar with Lifecycle Services (LCS), Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices for D365

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders — bridging the technical and functional worlds

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector or international development finance

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve. You will work with:

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O)

  • Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)

  • Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse)

  • Microsoft Fabric & Azure Data Services

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

  • Several fit-for-purpose SaaS solutions and integrations

 

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact

  • A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment

  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning

  • A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

 

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's Development Finance Institution. We aim to be a best-in-class impact investor by making commercial private sector investments that support the green transition, as well as building just and inclusive societies in developing countries and emerging markets. Impact Fund Denmark has a strong focus on creating sustainable and responsible businesses, which generate measurable social, economic, and climate impacts as well as solid financial returns.

 

Ready to build the financial engine behind global impact?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: (Senior) Power Apps & Web Application Developer (Dynamics 365 & Dataverse)
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Build the digital backbone that powers our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance teams

 

Do you want to be hands-on in building the platform that powers how we manage every investment, from lead through to exit? And are you ready to take technical ownership of a growing, business-critical application that combines low-code Power Apps with modern JavaScript/Node.js web development, used every day by our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance colleagues?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

 

Here is what you get with us:

  • A hands-on, technically deep role at the centre of our internal Investment Management application, spanning both Power Platform and custom web application development

  • Close collaboration with our Business Application Manager and external development resources, as part of a small, focused core development team

  • The opportunity to shape a platform still early in its journey — with a clear roadmap and real influence over how it evolves, including its growing web application layer

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

On this application specifically, you will work day-to-day alongside our Business Application Manager, who coordinates prioritisation and the release process, and a small pool of external developers who provide specialist and overflow capacity. Together, you form the core development team — working closely with Product Owners, Super Users, and functional subject-matter experts from Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to keep the backlog moving and the platform improving.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our internal investment management application

Our internal Investment Management application is built on Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, and the Dynamics 365 platform (using only capabilities that do not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence). It supports the full investment lifecycle — from lead and screening, through portfolio management and monitoring, to exit. Alongside this low-code foundation, an increasing share of the application is built as custom web applications — using JavaScript and Node.js — to deliver functionality that goes beyond what Power Apps supports out of the box.

We are looking for a Power Apps & Web Application Developer to take day-to-day technical ownership of the application's codebase and configuration and be the technical lead for the application and its growth over the coming years. You will work closely with our Business Application Manager and external developer resources as the core development team, turning a continuously prioritised backlog into reliable, well-built functionality for the business — spanning both the Power Platform and our custom web application components. You will take the lead on deciding when a requirement is best solved with low-code Power Apps versus custom web development, in dialogue with the Business Application Manager.

You will, for example:

  • Platform development: design, build, and maintain Power Apps (model-driven and canvas) and Dataverse solution components — tables, relationships, business rules, and automation — that underpin the application

  • Web application development: design, build, and maintain custom web applications and services using JavaScript and Node.js, extending the platform beyond native Power Apps capabilities and integrating tightly with Dataverse via APIs

  • Dynamics 365 configuration: configure and extend Dynamics 365 platform capabilities used within the application, strictly limited to functionality that does not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence

  • Process automation: build Power Automate flows that automate approvals, notifications, and data flows between the application, our ERP, and other enterprise systems

  • Backlog delivery: work from the prioritised Kanban backlog together with the Business Application Manager, who owns the board and coordinates prioritisation and release

  • Requirements translation: engage directly with super users and functional SMEs across Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to understand needs and translate them into technical designs

  • Collaboration with external resources: coordinate day-to-day with external developers on shared backlog items, ensuring consistent quality, patterns, and documentation across the codebase

  • Testing and release: support structured testing cycles and releases, working with super users to validate functionality before it reaches the wider organisation

  • Production support: troubleshoot and resolve issues in the live application — both the Power Platform components and the custom web application layer — protecting data integrity and keeping the platform reliable for daily use

  • Documentation: maintain clear technical documentation of the data model, configurations, and customisations to support governance and knowledge transfer

 

You bring hands-on Power Platform and web development skills, and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and modern web development, you become invested in turning business requirements from investment, risk, valuation, or finance stakeholders into robust, well-structured solutions.

We imagine that you:

  • Technical foundation: have a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Platform expertise: have solid hands-on experience developing with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), and Power Automate

  • Web development skills: have solid hands-on experience building web applications and services with JavaScript and Node.js, and are comfortable working across both front-end and back-end code

  • Dynamics 365 knowledge: understand Dynamics 365 as a platform, including entity modelling, business rules, and security roles

  • Collaborative delivery: are comfortable working from a shared, continuously prioritised backlog alongside a Business Application Manager and external developers

  • Communication: communicate clearly with both technical colleagues and non-technical business stakeholders across departments

  • Problem-solving: take a structured, hands-on approach to troubleshooting issues in a live, business-critical application

  • Have experience with plugin development (C#) or PCF component development on the Power Platform

  • Are familiar with Azure DevOps and ALM practices for Power Platform and web application deployment

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience with modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries (such as React, Vue, or Express) for building web applications

  • Having domain knowledge from investment management, risk, valuation, or finance processes, is a plus

  • Have experience from the financial sector or an impact-focused organisation, is a plus

 

Our technology stack

jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that.

The Social Comms role: We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

  • You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.
  • You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.
  • You've run or grown popular social accounts before.
  • You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.
  • You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.
  • You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.
  • You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.
  • You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.

Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based  is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. Please send your CV in English.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

LOCATION & TRAVEL

jobs.title: Tugiisik
jobs.description:
tugiisik 3-aastasele rõõmsale ja armsale poisile

Tööülesanded: Tugiisiku töö toimub peamiselt lapse abistajana heas eestikeelses tavalasteaias. Lapsel on kõne hilistumine, kuid vaatamata kõne puudumisele on ta kõigest huvituv, lustlik ja aktiivne. Ta on liikumisel ja tegevustes osav, ettevaatlik ning vaatlev-uuriv. Vahetevahel võib ta olla ka ulakas ja mitte kohe kuuletuda.
Laps vajab tugiisiku abi ja juhendamist eelkõige: • lasteaia tegevustest osa võtmisel; • lasteaia päevakava ja kodukorra järgimisel; • riietumisel; • söömisel; • hügieenitoimingutel; • turvalisuse ja järelevalve tagamisel. Tugiisiku jaoks on laps väga tore ja pigem kerge klient: ta on hästi kontakteeruv, rõõmsameelne ja koostöövalmis.

Omalt poolt pakume: Tugiisik võetakse tööle Tallina Perekeskuse poolt käsunduslepinguga. Töökoormus, tööaeg ja motivatsioonisüsteem on läbiräägitavad.

Muud nõuded: Tugiisikuks sobib täisealine inimene, kes on läbinud tugiisiku koolituse ja/või töötanud eelnevalt lastega.
Kandidaadilt ootame sobivaid isikuomadusi, head suhtlemisoskust, rahulikku meelt, usaldusväärsust ja valmisolekut lapse igapäevast toimetulekut toetada. Tugiisik peab: • oskama näha last tervikuna; • suutma suhelda lapse, tema pere ja lähedastega; • suutma kanda vastutust lapse ohutuse ja turvalisuse eest; • tegutsema vastavalt olukorrale; • järgima vastastikuse usalduse, lugupidamise ja konfidentsiaalsuse põhimõtteid. Tugiisik peab läbima korrapärase tervisekontrolli nakkushaiguste suhtes, sealhulgas iga kahe aasta järel kopsude röntgenuuringu. Tugiisikul peab olema tervisekontrolli läbimise kohta perearsti väljastatud tervisetõend. Tugiisikuks ei sobi inimene, kes on süüdi mõistetud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest või kes ei vasta muudele seadustes sätestatud nõuetele.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Daglig Leder til Beni Burger i Carlsbergbyen
jobs.description:
Beni er en ny burgerbar i Carlsberg Byen, skabt i samarbejde mellem Norrlyst Koncernen og Casper Drømme. Vi har rygende travlt og søger derfor en dygtig og engageret daglig leder, der har lyst til at være en central del af den daglige drift og udviklingen af Beni.

Som daglig leder bliver du den, der sikrer, at restauranten spiller – både foran gæsterne og bag kulisserne. Du får et tæt samarbejde med teamet og ledelsen og kommer til at have ansvar for den daglige drift af Front of House.

DINE PRIMÆRE ANSVARSOMRÅDER

  • Daglig drift – sikre, at restauranten fungerer optimalt fra åbning til luk.

  • Personaleplanlægning – udarbejdelse af vagtplaner, koordinering af medarbejdere og sikring af det rette hold på gulvet.

  • Varebestilling – holde styr på lager, forbrug og bestilling af varer, så vi altid er klar til service.

  • Floor management – være synlig og nærværende på gulvet, lede teamet under service og sikre den gode gæsteoplevelse.

Stillingen er en kombination af administrative opgaver og hands-on drift i restauranten. Du skal derfor både trives foran computeren med planlægning og koordinering og på gulvet, hvor tempoet er højt, og beslutningerne skal træffes hurtigt.

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

Har erfaring fra en lignende rolle i restaurantbranchen – gerne fra et koncept med højt tempo, mange gæster og fokus på både kvalitet og effektiv drift.

Du er struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt. Du tager ansvar, går forrest og har naturlig autoritet uden at være bange for selv at tage fat, når der skal gives gas på gulvet.

Du har blik for både gæster, kolleger og driften og forstår, at den gode restaurantoplevelse skabes af et stærkt team, tydelig ledelse og godt købmandskab.

VI TILBYDER

  • En fuldtidsstilling som daglig leder på Beni.

  • En central rolle i et nyt og ambitiøst burgerkoncept.

  • Mulighed for at være med til at forme og udvikle restauranten fra starten.

  • Et stærkt team og en arbejdsplads med højt tempo, godt humør og masser af energi.

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig sammen med Norrlyst Koncernen.

Stillingen er med start hurtigst muligt.

Hvis du kan se dig selv stå i spidsen for den daglige drift på Beni, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Odense
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens

jobs.title: Business Development Manager til Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed
jobs.description:
CenSec – Center for Defence, Space & Security 

Vil du arbejde med at styrke vækst, innovation og internationalisering inden for den danske forsvarssektor? Og være med til at udvikle Danmarks nationale innovations- og erhvervsklynge for aktører inden for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed?   

  

Om stillingen 

CenSecs mission er at være drivkraften bag et stærkt dansk SMV-økosystem, der former fremtidens løsninger inden for forsvar, sikkerhed og rum – og som Business Development Manager kommer du til at spille en vigtig rolle her.   

Du kommer til at arbejde primært med klyngens forsvarsdomæne og med et særligt fokus på droner, autonome enheder og internationalt samarbejde. 

En del af arbejdet udføres på tværs af projekter, hvor du vil få ansvaret for leverancerne heri, som bl.a. indbefatter dialog med industrien.  

Du får til opgave at planlægge og afvikle forskellige klyngeaktiviteter, lige fra mindre netværksmøder til større konferencer. Klyngeaktiviteterne skal hjælpe CenSecs medlemmer med at få ny viden, skabe samarbejde på tværs og øge medlemmernes kommercielle udvikling. Aktiviteterne har både nationalt og internationalt fokus. 

Udover arbejdet med klyngeaktiviteterne får du til opgave at rekruttere nye medlemmer, være kontaktperson for medlemsvirksomheder og deltage i interne udviklingsopgaver- og processer.  

Arbejdet med udvikling af klyngen omfatter også en del administration, opgaver relateret til formidling og kommunikation, samt samarbejde med andre aktører i det forsvarsindustrielle økosystem på både nationalt og europæisk niveau.  

 

Din profil 

Der kan være mange indgangsvinkler til denne stilling, og vi stiller derfor ikke krav til en særlig baggrund. Vigtigst er det at du er en “do’er”, som har vilje og evne til at omsætte input og viden til konkret værdi for vores medlemmer og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forventer en høj grad af selvstændighed og professionalisme, og at du kan varetage det ansvar og mandat, der medfølger at være ansat i den nationale klyngeorganisation for forsvarsindustrien. 

Derudover er du ekstrovert, kommunikativt stærk, omstillingsparat, fleksibel og taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau. 

 

Vi tilbyder 

En betydningsfuld rolle i en internationalt anerkendt klyngeorganisation, som skaber innovation, vækst og arbejdspladser. Du får opgaver og muligheder, der medfører faglig og personlig udvikling i et internationalt miljø med ansvar efter evner og ambitioner.  

Dine kollegaer er ambitiøse, humoristiske og uformelle, og trods forskellige ansvarsområder, arbejder vi sammen som et team og hjælper hinanden.  

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsuge med to ugentlige fremmødedage på vores kontor i Viborg og hjemmearbejde de resterende ugedage.  

 

Arbejdstid og løn m.m. 

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt på funktionærvilkår. 

I forbindelse med projekt- og klyngeaktiviteter i ind- og udland vil der være nogen rejseaktivitet, som altid aftales på forhånd og i god tid. 

Løn efter kvalifikationer og evner til at skabe værdi for CenSec. 

 

Læs mere om CenSec her: www.censec.dk  

 

Om CenSec 

CenSec er Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed.  

Som national klynge er vores mandat at samle og styrke hele økosystemet, heriblandt virksomheder, videninstitutioner og myndigheder. 

Vi har en dyb forståelse af økosystemet og en dybdegående viden om vores medlemmer. Vores ambition er at være et omdrejningspunkt hvor alle aktører ser os som den primære drivkraft til at fremme samarbejde på tværs og øge innovation i industrien.  
  
Vi er en tillidsbaseret og stærk medlemsorganisation. Siden 2004 har vi arbejdet for at styrke netværk, samarbejds- og forretningsmuligheder på tværs af sektorer og grænser, gennem facilitering af nationale og internationale netværksaktiviteter.  
  
CenSec – skaber innovation, vækst og robusthed for Danmark.  

  

Ansøgning 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt venligst Anders Laustsen, på tlf. 52 13 15 42 eller skriv til anders@censec.dk  

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV til samme mailadresse snarest muligt og senest den 27. september 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført løbende med henblik på ansættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi forbeholder os ret til at ansætte før deadline, hvis vi finder den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.
  • Developing HVAC philosophies, specifications, diagrams, technical requisitions and other project documentation.
  • Compliance, HSE & Quality Assurance: Ensure full compliance with applicable standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, while supporting and adhering to health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Specifying HVAC equipment and supporting procurement, bid evaluation, vendor follow-up and document review.
  • Coordinating technical interfaces with electrical, structural, piping, fire protection and control system disciplines, and participating in client meetings and design reviews.
  • Supporting fabrication, testing and commissioning activities, including FATs, SATs and site support when required, while adhering to health, safety and environmental standards.

Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured and solution-oriented Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about HVAC design and wants to make a personal contribution to offshore renewable energy projects. You collaborate effectively across disciplines, communicate clearly and take ownership of your engineering deliverables.
We are looking for an outgoing and positive professional who is passionate about renewable energy and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to help innovate the future of sustainable solutions

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with HVAC engineering and design, preferably from industrial, marine, energy or offshore projects.
  • Knowledge of ventilation, cooling, refrigeration, heating and pressurization systems, including DX and water-based cooling solutions.
  • Experience with technical documentation, equipment specifications and coordination in multidisciplinary EPC projects; offshore substation, offshore wind, marine or industrial plant experience is considered a strong advantage.
  • Professional English communication skills and a strong commitment to teamwork, quality and safety.
  • A strong focus on quality and safety, demonstrated through attention to detail and adherence to HSE requirements.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
For questions, contact Rafid Kajo, Manager, Mechanical & HVAC, at +45 7916 6867 or +45 3016 6613

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.description:
Rengøringstekniker søges – gerne med erfaring i gulv- og murbehandling

Vi søger en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst rengøringstekniker, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team. Vi lægger vægt på godt håndværk, grundighed og høj service – og vi ser meget gerne, at du har erfaring med specialrengøring, gulvbehandling og behandling af murværk/facader.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil variere og kan blandt andet omfatte:

  • Daglig og periodisk rengøring

  • Hovedrengøring og specialrengøring

  • Gulvbehandling, herunder grundrens, skuring, polish og pleje af forskellige gulvtyper

  • Maskinel gulvrengøring

  • Klargøring og efterbehandling af overflader

  • Anvendelse af professionelle rengøringsmaskiner, produkter og metoder

  • Kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Dialog og god service over for kunder

Vi forestiller os, at du

Har erfaring som rengøringstekniker eller med professionel rengøring. Det er en stor fordel, hvis du har praktisk erfaring med gulvbehandlinger og mur-/facadebehandlinger og er vant til at arbejde med maskiner og professionelle rengøringsmidler.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og går op i at levere et flot resultat. Samtidig forventer vi, at du er stabil, fleksibel og serviceminded og kan indgå positivt i et team.

Relevant uddannelse eller kurser inden for rengøring og overfladebehandling er en fordel, men praktisk erfaring og den rette indstilling vægter højt.

Kørekort B er en fordel

Vi tilbyder

Et alsidigt job med forskellige typer opgaver og mulighed for at bruge dine faglige kompetencer inden for både almindelig rengøring og specialopgaver.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed og godt samarbejde. Vi tilbyder gode kolleger, grundig introduktion til opgaverne og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Send en kort ansøgning og gerne dit CV. Fortæl gerne om din erfaring med professionel rengøring og særligt, hvis du har arbejdet med gulvbehandling, specialrengøring eller mur-/facadebehandling.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: AI Response Analyst
jobs.description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.Â 

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling around agreed deadlines.

  • Tasks include visual content, so a device and connection that display images comfortably are required.

  • Volume varies with project demand.

  • The rate of pay will be specified in the job offer

Location: Copenhagen Denmark

Position: Full-Time

We are in need of a committed and talented baker to come onboard and join our dymanic team. The position is a 40hrs work week, regular shift patterns and a great environment.

As an experience baker you will be a vital part of our incredible baking team. BUKA Bakery in Copenhagen, Denmark is known for their extraordinary croissants and sourdough bread. Our production is located in the center of Copenhagen, catering to five BUKA outlets.

We work hard to ensure that the bakery at BUKA are a place of learning, creating and enjoyment.

• Be methodical and diligent and have good attention to detail.

• Be passionate about eating, baking, tasting, and teaching others how to be the same.

• Have an unwavering determination to make delicious bread and pastry!

• Have at least one year's experience of cooking in a professional environment.

• Be patient, calm; a natural teacher.

• Be keen to learn from your employers.

jobs.title: Cohort 0
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the Role

Join Replit's key teams across the company, such as AI Research, Strategic Finance, or the Office of the CEO, for a unique paid internship built for sharp quantitative and creative minds. You will work alongside our top executives, in addition to world-class engineers, designers, and finance team on some of the hardest problems in AI-native software creation and accelerating key areas of our business.



We are creating a dedicated track for students with strong mathematical backgrounds because the problems we are solving sit at the intersection of deep math and applied AI, including agent reasoning, systems optimization, and improving how our models learn and perform at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of users build software.




You Will:

 - Contribute to real engineering problems that push the boundaries of AI-powered software creation

 - Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers on infrastructure that powers Replit's platform

 - Prototype novel approaches to problems in AI, systems, or tooling where mathematical rigor is the differentiator

 - Ship work that impacts millions of developers globally, in an environment where your ideas are heard and often implemented



Required Skills and Experience:

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field

 - At least one semester of schooling remaining after the internship

 - Demonstrated excellence in competitive mathematics such as IMO and IOI, quantitative research, or advanced coursework

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, agent systems, company building, or developer tooling

 - Extremely bullish on Replit and the future of AI-native software creation. We would love to see what you have built on the platform
   



What We Value:

 - First-principles thinking: Ability to break down complex problems from the ground up and reason about them rigorously

 - Mathematical intuition: Strong grasp of the underlying math behind machine learning, optimization, or systems

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating well with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication: Ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Curiosity and speed: Genuine excitement for hard problems and the drive to iterate quickly



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Kierownik (K/M) w Dziale Administracjii - nabór
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Zakres realizowanych zadań na stanowisku:
1. Kierowanie pracami Działu Administracji; dokonywanie podziału zadań
podległym pracownikom i ich nadzór.
2. Prawidłowe i sprawne wykonywanie zadań, przestrzeganie przepisów prawa oraz
porządku i dyscypliny w ramach kierowania działem.
3. Terminowość i rzetelność załatwianych spraw wynikających z realizacji powierzonych
zadań.
4. Racjonalne wykorzystywanie środków w ramach zatwierdzonych budżetów.
5. Kontrola prawidłowości zakupów, transportu i dostaw.
6. Przygotowanie okresowych ocen, analiz, informacji, i sprawozdań.
7. Kontrola rachunków pod względem merytorycznym za zrealizowane zlecenia,
zamówienia i umowy.
8. Coroczne określanie podstawy do naliczenia podatku od nieruchomości, oraz z tytułu
trwałego zarządu.
9. Nadzór nad brygadą remontową.
10. Monitorowanie wykorzystania kart drogowych przez pracowników Działu, oraz
prawidłowości rozliczenia kosztów eksploatacji pojazdów służbowych.
11. Wydawanie i podpisywania zaświadczeń w sprawach wynikających z działalności
Działu.
12. Wykonywanie innych zadań nie objętych zakresem czynności, a zleconych przez
Dyrektora MOPS.
Praca w systemie jednozmianowym w godz. 7.30-15.30 od PN do PT.
Umowa o pracę na czas określony 6 miesięcy.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wymagania niezbędne związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Posiadanie obywatelstwa polskiego z zastrzeżeniem art. 11 ust. 2 i 3 ustawy o pracownikach samorządowych.
2. Posiadanie pełnej zdolności do czynności prawnych oraz korzystania w pełni z praw publicznych.
3. Brak skazania prawomocnym wyrokiem sądu za umyślne przestępstwo ścigane z oskarżenia publicznego lub umyślne przestępstwo skarbowe.
4. Posiadanie wykształcenia wyższego.
5. Posiadanie minimum 4 lata stażu pracy w ramach umowy o pracę.
6. Koncepcja organizacji pracy Działu Administracji.
Wymagania dodatkowe związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Preferowane doświadczenie w pracy w obszarze administracji na stanowisku urzędniczym

jobs.title: Field Marketer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. Often, these users and champions are different than the person who has enterprise purchasing authority.

The Demand Generation team serves as a dot-connecter across sales, marketing, and operation teams to identify, engage, and convert decision makers at our target mid market and enterprise companies.

In this role, you will partner with demand generation teammates and sales stakeholders to ideate and execute in-person events, designed to help open, accelerate, and close business.

As a Field Marketing Manager, you will own and execute field events that are Notion-hosted, third party, co-partnered, and ancillary to third party events. This strategic position focuses on driving pipeline that meaningfully contribute to Notion's bottom line.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Delight Notion customers and prospects, with a guest-first approach to creating field events and experiences that bring the Notion brand and product to life.

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make recommendations on how we invest in field events to drive incremental business impact.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts

 - Partner with our Operation and BizTech teams to manage and better utilize our go-to-market systems




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4-5+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment

 - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses

 - Salesforce, Marketo experience



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000-$160,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to help manage relationships with Linear’s top customers. As a part of the early team, you’ll play a pivotal role in laying the foundation and setting up best practices. You will champion our customers’ needs and ensure they realize the full value of Linear across their organization. Your role will involve onboarding new customers, delivering ongoing support + enablement, and fostering strong relationships to drive customer satisfaction and retention.

Location & work mode

 - Drive customer onboarding and training on Linear’s features and best practices; continually strive to expand the usage and adoption of Linear within accounts

What we're looking for

jobs.title: Senior Analyst International Accountability Platform for Belarus
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced international justice analyst motivated by the opportunity to turn complex information and evidence of violations of international law in Belarus into meaningful action for accountability?

Then DIGNITY can offer you an exciting opportunity as Senior Analyst of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB). Join a highly committed international team and play a meaningful role in advancing international justice and accountability. You will enjoy genuine responsibility, be able to shape impactful work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative culture—whether working remotely or from the office.

The IAPB was created in March 2021 as a consortium of Belarusian and international human rights organisations who joined forces to collect, verify, preserve and analyse evidence of violations of international criminal law and international human rights law allegedly committed by Belarusian authorities since 2020. To this end, the platform directly supports national criminal justice authorities and international accountability mechanisms by providing information and evidence. The IAPB’s objective is to achieve accountability of perpetrators and enable redress for the victims. Its operations were recently extended until end of September 2029.

DIGNITY, as the lead organisation of the consortium, hosts the IAPB’s Secretariat within which the position is located.

Since 1982, DIGNITY has worked for a world free of torture and violence. We are a human rights and development organisation that also runs a rehabilitation clinic in Denmark. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims, and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be held accountable.


About the position

As Senior Analyst your focus will be to ensure that evidence is gathered in line with international standards; that timely and high-quality responses to requests by national and international accountability mechanisms are drafted, involving structuring, drafting and reviewing of submissions and analytical briefs; and that the work of the IAPB’s analysts and open-source researchers is well coordinated.

Your primary tasks are:

  • Overseeing the consolidation and analysis of information and evidence gathered by IAPB’s partners and the secretariat team;
  • Strategic planning as well as overseeing the IAPB’s analytical work to support criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies, in close coordination with the Senior Legal Consultant;
  • Drafting, reviewing and editing of analytical briefs and legal memos for submission to criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies;
  • Supervising and coordinating the work conducted by analysts and consultants, including setting priorities/tasks and ensuring high standards of work, in close coordination with the Legal Advisor.
  • Cooperating with prosecution authorities and international mechanisms.
  • Other reasonable duties corresponding to ability and training.

The position is expected to include up to 25 days of travel abroad per year.

We offer you:

  • The opportunity to work as part of a highly committed international team of skilled and experienced colleagues, united by a strong sense of purpose and a collaborative team spirit that has been successfully fostered across a remote working environment.
  • The chance to make a tangible contribution to international justice, supporting work that can have concrete, real-world impact for accountability.
  • A high degree of responsibility and meaningful involvement, with the opportunity to shape the work of the platform.
  • A stimulating and purpose-driven working environment, offering opportunities to engage with complex and international criminal law and accountability issues.
  • A supportive and collegial culture, where knowledge-sharing, mutual respect and constructive collaboration are valued.
  • The flexibility of an office environment or remote working environment, combined with an established culture of communication, collaboration and connection across the team.


Skills

We expect you to hold a university degree in law (at undergraduate or postgraduate level), preferably with a specialisation in international criminal law.

We also expect that you have:

  • A minimum of 10 years of demonstrated practical professional experience in the documentation of violations of international law, preferably in the context of international criminal law. This experience should include substantial hands-on investigative or documentation work and not be primarily academic in nature.
  • A minimum of 5 years analytical and investigative experience in relation to violations of international criminal law, in particular crimes against humanity, including the assessment and analysis of relevant facts, evidence, and applicable legal frameworks.
  • Demonstrated legal drafting skills, including experience in conceptualising, structuring and drafting of submissions to national and international human rights and accountability bodies.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating and overseeing the work of a team of analysts, including allocating and reviewing work and providing substantive guidance to members of the IAPB team in a remote working environment.
  • Experience with universal and extra-territorial jurisdiction cases.
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with criminal justice stakeholders, including national and/or international accountability bodies.
  • Experience representing an organisation at external events, including conferences or other forums, with the confidence to speak to a range of audiences.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Fluency in Russian and/or Belarusian will be given particular weight in the selection process.
  • Direct experience interviewing survivors and witnesses is desirable.

It is also important that you have:

  • Excellent communication skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with different target audiences.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong organisational and inter-personal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an inter-disciplinary environment and across different cultures.
  • Ability to work across a broad portfolio, manage complex workload and be responsive to evolving demands.
  • Cultural and context sensitivity, high ethical standards, and diplomatic skills.
  • and that you are resourceful, creative, collegial, empathic, and respectful.


Terms of employment

The position is placed in the Secretariat of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB), of which DIGNITY is the lead organisation. The IAPB is managed by the Head of the Platform and Dignity’s Director of the Prevention & Accountability Department.

The position is placed in Dignity’s head office in Copenhagen (Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Kbh. Ø), but we alternatively offer an employer of record (EoR) solution if you are based in another EU member state. Please note that the position will not be filled on a consultancy basis.

The employment is based on the Danish collective agreement for academics in the Danish State, and the salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 50-52.500 (gross, monthly) + pension (18,07%). If you are offered an EoR solution, the salary will depend on comparable positions and terms of employment in the host country.

Expected entry is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter; the position is currently envisaged until 30 September 2029.


More info

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting the IAPB Secretariat at iapb@dignity.dk.

The application consisting of CV, letter of motivation, diploma and other documents if relevant are submitted via the link no later than 27 September 2026.

We expect to hold interviews on 15-16 October 2026 digitally, and possibly also a second round of interviews on 20-21 October 2026, which will also take place digitally.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/

The IAPB is composed of two Belarusian co-lead organisations, Human Rights Center Viasna and International Committee for the Investigation of Torture in Belarus, and its lead organisation DIGNITY – Danish Institute against Torture.

Since its establishment, it has continued to expand its evidence base and analytical outputs, collecting testimonies of some 2,900 victims and witnesses, over 38,000 victim-related documents and over 2.1 million open-source items, including extensive audiovisual and textual materials.

Cooperation with accountability mechanisms contributed to the decision of the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court to open an investigation into crimes against humanity related to the Lithuania/Belarus situation. Overall, by June 2026, the Platform had responded to 14 requests from national jurisdictions and prepared 13 submissions to multiple international mechanisms.

As part of its survivor-centred approach, so far it has provided mental health and psychosocial support to 850 beneficiaries.

Beyond documentation and support activities, the IAPB promotes accountability pathways for Belarus, outlined in its report “Paths to Accountability for Belarus”.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 23, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Shaw Commercials Group in Castlebar is currently recruiting for Business Analyst position. Reporting to the Managing Director / Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play an important role in the business with have multiple responsibilities and duties that will span across various departments. This is a busy work environment working to weekly and monthly deadlines. Collaborate with business leaders, department heads, and operational teams to understand business needs, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear and actionable requirements. Analyse existing business processes, workflows, systems, and reporting structures to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement across business and operational functions. Document, structure, and prioritise business requirements to support the development and implementation of practical, technology-driven solutions. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation, with a focus on improving efficiency, accuracy, cost effectiveness, and overall business performance. Identify opportunities for automation and AI integration across daily, weekly, and monthly reporting and operational processes. Develop and support automated reporting solutions using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other reporting or data visualisation tools. Explore and support the introduction of AI-based tools and automation technologies to reduce manual workload in areas including reporting, data entry, scheduling, forecasting, and operational analysis. Work with internal teams and external IT providers to support the design, development, and implementation of business systems and digital solutions. Support system integration activities to ensure new tools and platforms operate effectively with existing business systems, processes, and workflows. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure business requirements are clearly communicated, understood, and appropriately delivered. Assist with solution design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support for new systems and business process changes. Develop and enhance management reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to support effective, data-driven decision-making. Support the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data across reporting and operational systems. Promote appropriate data governance practices, including compliance with GDPR and internal data security requirements. Translate technical concepts into clear business language and communicate business requirements effectively to technical stakeholders. Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Promote continuous improvement and digital innovation across the organisation by identifying and supporting smarter and more efficient ways of working.

jobs.title: Qualified Carpenter with Glazing Experience - Construction - Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Dansk version længere nede

Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

You’ll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we’re not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

  • You are a qualified carpenter

  • You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

  • You have a valid driving licence

  • You can communicate in English

  • Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

  • A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

  • Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

  • Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

  • Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

  • Pension scheme

  • Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

  • Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write “Bonde Glas” in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe’s largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

  • Du har kendskab til eller praktisk erfaring med glarmesterfaget

  • Du har kørekort

  • Timeløn på 150-200 kr. i timen afhængigt af kvalifikationer og erfaring

  • Der kan forekomme overarbejde, men som udgangspunkt er der ikke weekendarbejde

  • Pensionsordning

Om Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas er en lokal glarmestervirksomhed på Lolland. Ud over glarmesterarbejde har virksomheden også tømrere ansat og udfører mange forskellige praktiske opgaver.

Første samtale kan afholdes online, hvis det er nødvendigt. Udvalgte kandidater kan blive inviteret til at besøge arbejdspladsen, inden der indgås en endelig ansættelsesaftale.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og opfordrer interesserede kandidater til at søge hurtigst muligt.

Martin Hansen
Virksomhedskonsulent, Lolland Kommune
